verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo, the headphone graphic, a large 'Obsidian One' headline and a visible cyan 'Pre-order, $349' CTA, so the hierarchy holds. But the stats are scattered in fragments (-38 dB bottom-left, 6 mics/10 min top-right, a row of BT 5.4/40h/250g along the bottom), the legal line is unreadably small, and the right side is cramped. B has no visible CTA at all and the OBSIDIAN logo is faded to very low contrast. Its stats are split into tiny clusters on both ends, the legal text sits jammed above the headline, and the headphone graphic is shrunk into a gap between the headline and the stats, so it fails both brand and action.
